name: Zep AI
long_description: Zep unifies business data, documents, and conversations into shared, governed context so agents can complete tasks correctly. Its Context Lake manages millions of Context Graphs as one system, with access controls, retention policies, source traceability, and audit logs. Teams use Zep to build enterprise context graphs, agent memory, and customer and account context. Zep retrieves context in under 200 milliseconds. Graphiti, Zep’s open source framework for temporal knowledge graphs, has more than 30,000 GitHub stars.
one_liner: The unified context layer for enterprise data
